answer: Tide-Locked Attestation Windows. Each agent publishes periodic signed attestations during randomized windows; validators sample and cross-check them against a shared tundra of historical records. Duplicate identities diverge because copied agents cannot synchronize independent timing. Any agent failing to carry a unique lantern marker across three consecutive windows is slashed. Attackers must maintain genuinely distinct synchronized responders per identity, multiplying operational cost linearly per sybil.
